The device is shown against a white background. The screen displays a user interface, but the content appears distorted and partially melted into the keyboard area. There is a significant visual artifact where a blue, liquid-like substance and a pale, fleshy/organic mass seem to be emerging from or melting into the keyboard and lower screen area.
